photos.alt: A single carved jack-o'lantern glows orange at the left of an almost black frame, its light pooling on the dark surface below.
photos.notes: Best hero: roughly 60% of the frame is pure dark space for the headline and RSVP card. Keep the pumpkin on the left third (object-position 27% 55%), put text on the right or top. Works with a plum/black gradient overlay and a candle-flicker animation. Landscape only; on portrait phones crop to the pumpkin.

photos.alt: Two carved jack-o'lanterns stacked one above the other, their jagged grins glowing amber against a pitch-black background.
photos.notes: Symmetrical and centred, so it crops well to square or 4:5 for a gallery tile or the "house rules" card. Very dark edges let it blend into a near-black section background.

photos.alt: A white crackle-glaze Venetian jester mask with gold filigree, a red and gold peaked cap and small bells, lit against a black background.
photos.notes: Showpiece for the masquerade dress-code section. Subject is centred with black margins, so it takes square, 4:5 or wide crops; gold and crimson match the tarnished gold / blood red palette.

photos.alt: A wine glass of bright red drink beside a glossy red skull-shaped bottle and scattered candy eyeballs on a black background.
photos.notes: Perfect for the "Bloody Hour" cocktail menu. Portrait 2:3 with the top third empty black, so a title or price list can overlay the top; subjects sit in the lower 60%. Crop to square around the glass and bottle for a menu tile.

photos.alt: Tall cream taper candles streaked with red wax drips in a dark candelabra, beside an ornate bronze-gold skull and a pale rose on dark red fabric.
photos.colors: oxblood red, bronze gold, black, blush
photos.notes: Gothic table decor for the Séance Room or house-rules section. Portrait; the candle tops bleed off the frame, so keep the crop tall (4:5 or 2:3) and avoid a wide landscape crop that loses the skull.

photos.alt: A symmetrical brick Georgian country house at night, most of its windows and the front door glowing orange under a dark, cloudy navy sky.
photos.colors: midnight navy, ember orange, faint red
photos.notes: Reads instantly as "Hollow Hill House" for the venue and directions block. Dark sky above is usable for a caption. Landscape; also a strong second hero if the pumpkin hero is used elsewhere.

photos.alt: Three adults in dark Halloween costumes stand close together in a room washed in red light: one with a pale cloth mask over their face, a man in skull-style face paint and a leather jacket, and a woman in a twig crown and dark eye makeup.
photos.colors: black, blood red, bone-white face paint, violet shadow
photos.notes: Costume inspiration for the dress-code or guest-list section: adults in heavy makeup and masks, so not readily identifiable as individuals. It is a staged group portrait rather than a crowd at a party (no gothic, anonymous party-crowd shot was available), so frame it as 'dress the part', not 'last year's guests'. Portrait 2:3; keep the crop on the upper two thirds to hold the faces. Red wash matches the blood-red accent.

photos.alt: A tall black buttercream cake with black rosettes on top, drizzled with white spiderweb icing and a plastic spider, standing in drifts of fake cobweb on a dark slate surface.
photos.colors: charcoal black, ghost white, cool slate grey
photos.notes: The 'spooky bakes' shot for the menu or food section. Sharp studio still life, black and white on a dark slate ground, so it sits with the gothic palette with no tint needed (replaced a brighter orange graveyard cake on plastic plates that read as a kids' party). Portrait 2:3; the cake is centred and the dark top third is usable for a caption.

photos.alt: A glowing jack-o'lantern sits on the leaf-strewn ground of a dim forest at dusk, with blurred trees and soft lights behind it.
photos.notes: Second hero candidate: more atmosphere and depth than the main hero, but less empty space (top 40% is dark blurred trees, usable with an overlay). 4:3 landscape; keep the pumpkin lower-centre.

photos.alt: Five Venetian masks in black, gold, red and ivory arranged in a row against a black background.
photos.notes: Detail / divider shot: a wide, short strip (about 2.1:1) with masks centred on pure black. Use as a full-width band between sections or a masquerade banner; masks are small in frame so avoid tight crops.

photos.alt: A lone wooden house on a hill half hidden in thick grey fog, with a bare tree rising behind it.
photos.notes: Atmosphere shot for the venue or directions section, or a faded background behind the FAQ. Low contrast and grey, so tint it plum or darken it before putting text over it. Landscape 3:2.
